descriptionChirho: Masculine noun רְאֵם (re'em) denoting the wild ox or aurochs (Bos primigenius), a powerful wild bovine used as a symbol of strength. Occurs in both singular ('wild ox') and plural ('wild oxen') across Num 23:22, 24:8; Deut 33:17; Job 39:9-10; Ps 22:22, 29:6, 92:11; Isa 34:7. Eng 'wild ox / wild oxen,' Spa 'búfalo / búfalos,' Hin 'जंगली बैल / जंगली साँड़ों,' Arb 'رِئمٍ / الثِّيرَانِ الْوَحْشِيَّةِ,' Kor '들소 / 들소들,' Swa 'nyati.' Singular and plural inflections share the same referent.
